units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>אדם כּוֹבֵר בכברה …</he> if one sifts wheat or straw in a sieve. Ohol. XVIII, 2 <he>וכוֹבְרוֹ בשתי כברות</he> and sifts it twice.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:6">Maasr. I, 6</cite> <he>הקיטניות משיִכְבּוֹר</he> peas are subject to tithes from the time he sifts them. Ruth R., end <he>וכ׳ את הצבר וכ׳</he> (not <he>וכבד</he>) and sifted one pile.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:8:4">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ</cite> top … <he>טוחנין כוללין</he>, read <cite ref="K00189"><he>כּוֹבְרִין</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>כָּבוּר</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:6">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מן הכ׳ וכ׳</he> from the portion which has been sifted in behalf of that which has not.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:15">Tosef. Ter. X, 15</cite> <he>שדרכו לִיכָּבֵר</he> (not <he>לוכבד</he>) which it is customary to sift.
